children: American Integrity reported strong 2Q26 momentum with voluntary new business growth, $547M gross premiums written YTD and $370M shareholders' equity.
Ranked #1 public company voluntary new business writer in Florida; voluntary PIF growth 22% YTD and 54% voluntary new writings in 2Q26 vs 2Q25.
$547M gross premiums written for six months ended 6/30/2026 (+10% YoY) and 462K policies in force (+16% YoY).
$370M shareholders' equity as of 6/30/2026 and book value per share $18.86, supporting expansion initiatives.
Adjusted ROE of 40% (quarter) and $1.78 adjusted EPS noted, while adjusted net income was $55M for six months (-21% YoY).
Finalized 2026-2027 catastrophe XOL program: ~$430–$440M cost, $2.3B first-event tower, reduced aggregate retention and increased third-party coverage to $3B.
